name: Redis
summary: In-memory data store for caches, queues and sessions of your apps.
description:
Redis runs for your own apps only: it listens on a private port of 127.0.0.1 (shown on the app page) and requires the password of the app. Data is saved to the app's data folder (append-only file).

Node.js apps connect with redis://:PASSWORD@127.0.0.1:PORT.
post_install: Connect your apps to redis://:PASSWORD@127.0.0.1:PORT with the password and the port shown on the app page.
